wrds_queries.query: select permno,mbrstartdt,mbrenddt from crsp_a_indexes.dsp500list_v2 where mbrstartdt <= %(end)s and
select datadate,prccddiv from comp.idx_daily where gvkeyx='000003' and datadate between %(start)s an
select date,rf from ff.factors_daily where date between %(start)s and %(end)s order by date

vol_target: 15% annualized, 63 prior sessions, minimum 42 complete, selected basket, no leverage, cash earns zero
strict: no stale valuation or assumed delisting settlement
benchmark_holdings: daily historical constituent counts from supplementary membership query
